name: Ally Accessibility Suite
promise: Find, explain, repair, teach, and track accessibility without overstating evidence.
completion_criteria: A11yFinding round-trips across audit, learning, ticket, and browser surfaces without evidence loss.
WCAG Auditor unique rules and crawl behavior are ported or explicitly rejected with parity evidence.
One keyboard overlay remains after file, feature, permission, and runtime parity review.
Automated, AI-assisted, and manual assistive-technology evidence remain visibly distinct.

waves.objective: Create the WCAG Auditor to Ally rule, crawl, finding, and deliverable parity matrix.
waves.acceptance: Every unique behavior has an owner, fixture, and port or reject decision.

waves.objective: Port one unique deterministic rule end to end through A11yFinding and full-audit evidence.
waves.acceptance: Focused and full-suite gates pass and the manifest proves invocation and output.

waves.objective: Reconcile three keyboard overlays and select one canonical implementation.
waves.acceptance: Feature, file, permissions, browser, and accessibility parity evidence supports the decision.

waves.objective: Port remaining heuristic and narrow WCAG Auditor rule candidates with regression evidence.
waves.acceptance: Batch port of rule candidates produces verified A11yFindings with zero contract drift.

waves.objective: Round-trip A11yFinding contract through A11y Kitchen interactive teaching surface.
waves.acceptance: Pedagogical learner view renders authentic canonical finding without evidence loss.

waves.objective: Execute keyboard overlay consolidation: institute kb-overlay and freeze duplicate donors.
waves.acceptance: Single canonical overlay verified with minimized permissions and donor retirement status.
